tools.name: list_boards
tools.description: The 10 leaderboards on GitHub Hot Board: what each ranks, its canonical page URL and its JSON API endpoint.

tools.name: get_board
tools.description: Top-N rows of one leaderboard (rank, stars, forks, issues, language, description). Refreshes every ~6 hours; generatedAt is the batch stamp (fetch once per sync cycle).

tools.name: get_board_movers
tools.description: Repositories that genuinely moved rank on a board within the last 24 hours, from our own snapshot series (the same data as the on-site movers strip). Positive climb = went up.

tools.name: get_repo
tools.description: Library record for one repository: stars, forks, description in up to 16 UI languages (keys are locale codes), current overall-board rank if listed, pushedAt, and asOf freshness stamps. Served from our own dataset (no live GitHub API call); repos outside the library return not-in-library.

tools.name: search_library
tools.description: Search repositories tracked by this site, by owner/name (exact wins) or by keyword over descriptions (16 languages). Library-only: repos never listed on a board are not here. No live GitHub calls.

tools.name: get_repo_history
tools.description: Time series of one repository on one board (default overall): rank + star points at our sync cadence (~6h) from our own snapshot series — denser than the daily archives others publish. Empty result means the repo was not tracked in the window.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: list_boards, get_board · Private data: get_repo · Public sink: get_repo_history.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: list_boards, get_board · Private data: get_repo · Public sink: get_repo_history

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "get_board" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Top-N rows of one leaderboard (rank, stars, forks, issues, language, description). Refreshes in hourly batches; generatedAt is the batch stamp (fetch once per hour)." → after: "Top-N rows of one leaderboard (rank, stars, forks, issues, language, description). Refreshes every ~6 hours; generatedAt is the batch stamp (fetch once per sync cycle)."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
